note: Shoshone NF campground about 8.5 mi south of Lander on WY-131, between Sinks Canyon State Park and Popo Agie Falls, beside the Popo Agie River behind a band of riparian trees. Bear boxes. A trailhead near the falls leads into the Popo Agie Wilderness. Distinct from the Sinks Canyon State Park campgrounds. --Claude
